title: MSVC Build Tools variables
description: Configuration variables for Microsoft Visual C++ (MSVC) Build Tools and Windows SDK.

MSVC_VERSION.description: Specific version of MSVC Build Tools to install (e.g., '2022', '2026', or 'latest').

MSVC_ARCH.description: Target CPU architecture configured for cl.exe and dumpbin.exe ('x64', 'x86', or 'arm64').

MSVC_CRT.description: MSVC C Runtime linkage flag ('MT' for static CRT or 'MD' for dynamic CRT).

MSVC_DARICE_CUB_PATH.description: Filesystem path to Microsoft Windows SDK darice.cub 105-ICE validation oracle table.
